title: Nhume dzeNgoni neSimba
intro: Fungidzira masikati akanyarara akakanganiswa nekusvika kwevafambi vausingazive. Chitarisiko chavo hachina kujairika, asi chinangwa chavo hachina kufanana. Vanotakura shoko raMwari richachinja mafambiro emarudzi maviri, richiunza kuseka kumusha usina chinhu uye kutya muguta rine zvivi. Ndivanaani vaenzi ava vasinganzwisisike?
clues: Takatumirwa kumuranda akazvipira waAllah, anozivikanwa nekugamuchira vaeni vake zvisina muganho.
Takasvika takaita sevanhu vatisingazive, asi mugamuchiri wedu akanzwa chimwe chinhu chisinganzwisisike nezvekuvapo kwedu.
Takaunza mashoko akaita kuti mumwe mukadzi mukuru aseke asingatende, achishamisika zvikuru.
Takapihwa basa rekuchengetedza mhuri yakarurama uku tichinayisa kuparadzwa muguta rakazara nehuori.
Takaramba kudya chikafu chatakapihwa, izvo zvakawedzera kufungira kwemuenzi wedu.
Takaratidza hunhu hwedu hwechokwadi tisati taenda, tichiti, 'Zvirokwazvo, tiri vatumwa vaIshe wako.'
